scope: uniform global attenuation of the fixed invariant pair after its fold-2 whole-view failure, selected on folds 3 and 4 only

candidate.normalization: unlabeled fold x sensor rank/inverse-normal feature normalization and post-transform standardization
candidate.composition: exact current-score logit plus shrinkage times the complete fixed-pair logit residual

selection_rule: among candidates passing all point and bootstrap gates, maximize the smaller of the whole and low-prevalence paired-site AP lower bounds, then the individual lower bounds and preregistered point rank

target_domain.name: low-prevalence physical-location proxy for the official test-only-site view
target_domain.membership: all folds-3/4 rows from physical_location_id groups whose true scene-positive rate is <=0.05
target_domain.use: evaluation and gating only; no target-domain label or prevalence enters candidate scoring

invariants: The fixed pair, feature indices, directions, transforms, and full-strength component weights do not change.
Every candidate applies one scalar attenuation uniformly to every row; no site-conditioned routing or labels enter scoring.
Zero and one are excluded: zero is the unchanged current-score control and one is the independently rejected full-strength pair.
Every represented sample comes from an adapter that excluded its fold.
The low-prevalence definition affects evaluation only.
Both whole-development and low-prevalence paired-site AP lower bounds must be strictly positive.
Fold 2 is referenced only through its committed rejection report and its cache and labels are never reloaded.
Any development pass can authorize only a separately frozen confirmation on untouched folds 0 and 1.
Fresh data and exact-paper inputs remain inaccessible.
The explorer refuses to repeat or overwrite its full report.
